allowedProxies 为空时拒绝所有代理: deny all agents when allowedProxies is empty
blockedActions 始终覆盖 allow 规则: blockedActions always overrides the allow rule
Connection 是某个 Integration 下的授权身份。凭据加密保存: Connection is an Authorized Identity under an Integration.Credentials are stored encrypted, and lists and responses never echo secrets.
Credential JSON 必须是合法的对象: Credential JSON must be a legal object
Integration 名称在当前环境内唯一，后续 Connection 会归属: The Integration name is unique within the current environment, and subsequent connections will be attributed to it.
MCP、OpenAPI 文档、SDK 和 CLI 尚未实现，因此本页暂不提供对应: MCP, OpenAPI documentation, SDK and CLI have not yet been implemented, so the corresponding portal is not available on this page.
OAuth 2.0 实例需要授权地址、Token 地址和客户端 ID: OAuth 2.0 instance requires authorization address, token address and client ID
Runtime Token 只能调用被授权的 Action、Proxy 和 Co: Runtime tokens can only call authorized actions, proxies, and connections.Plaintext tokens are shown only once when they are created.
State + PKCE → 回调换取令牌 → 到期前自动刷新: State + PKCE → callback swap token automatically refreshes before → expiry
Token 已创建。数据库只保存高熵 Token 的 SHA-256 hash。: Token has been created.The database only stores SHA-256 hashes for high entropy tokens.
Webhook 测试事件已定向进入该端点的投递队列: Webhook test event has been directed into the delivery queue of this endpoint
管理端使用账号密码和服务端会话；运行时 Token 仅用于 /v1，并执行操作级: The management console uses email/password sign-in and server-side sessions. Runtime tokens are used only for /v1 and enforce operation-level permissions.
运行时 API 使用 Authorization: Bearer；管理 API: Runtime APIs use Authorization: Bearer. Management APIs use an HttpOnly cookie. Real credentials are never shown in the documentation.
# /api 使用账号密码登录后的 HttpOnly 会话 Cookie: # /api uses an HttpOnly session cookie created after email/password sign-in

按计划调用读取操作，去重保存结果，并记录检查点、重试和运行状态。: Run read operations on schedule, deduplicate saved results, and track checkpoints, retries, and status.

把多个 API 操作编排成步骤链或 DAG：模板传值、条件跳过、失败容忍与输出映: Compose multiple API actions into step chains or DAGs: template mapping, conditional skipping, failure tolerance and output mapping.
先创建集成与连接，再编排多步骤工作流；已接受的运行使用固定定义执行。: Create integrations and connections first, then compose multi-step workflows; accepted runs execute a pinned definition.
步骤可引用 trigger 与依赖闭包内的上游别名；编辑已部署工作流会回到草稿。: Steps can reference trigger and upstream aliases inside their dependency closure; editing a deployed workflow returns it to draft.
分钟 小时 日 月 周，IANA 时区生效。: minute hour day month weekday; evaluated in the IANA timezone.
省略 body 的运行时触发与定时运行使用该输入；不要写入凭据。: Used when runtime triggers omit the body and by scheduled runs; never store credentials here.
步骤（同层按此顺序执行）: Steps (same level runs in this order)
仅一个步骤时无需依赖: No dependencies needed with a single step
管理端触发进入队列并返回 202；此处轮询运行状态，完成后展示最终输出。: Admin triggers enqueue the run and return 202; this dialog polls the status and shows the final output when finished.
用 dependsOn 组合任意 DAG；引用上游响应字段时保持 JSON 类型: Compose any DAG with dependsOn; referenced upstream response fields keep their JSON types.
runIf 受限断言决定跳过；onError=continue 容忍失败并标记警: Restricted runIf assertions skip steps; onError=continue tolerates failures and marks warnings.
触发即固定图、输入与版本；编辑不影响已排队或运行中的执行。: Triggering pins the graph, input and versions; edits never affect queued or running executions.
